```{r load data}
biom2025 <- read_csv(here("raw data", "algae", "biomass_density_COMPLETE_2025.csv"))
coords2025 <- read_csv(here("raw data", "algae", "logbooks2025.csv"), locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"))
head(biom2025)
head(coords2025)
```
```{r trim coords}
coords_small <- coords2025 |> 
  mutate(
    Site = trimws(Site),
    Latitude = parse_number(as.character(Latitude)),
    Longitude = parse_number(as.character(Longitude))
  )  |> 
  select(Site, Latitude, Longitude)  |> 
  distinct(Site, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r modify data frame and merge coords}
quadrat_biom2025 <- biom2025 |> 
  rename(
    Bag.sample_weight = 'Bag+sample_weight',
    Site = site)|> 
  mutate(
    Site    = trimws(Site),
    biomass = pmax(Bag.sample_weight - bag_weight_g, 0)) |> 
  left_join(coords_small, by = "Site") |> 
  select(
    Site, 
    quadrat, 
    sample_type, 
    biomass, 
    Latitude, 
    Longitude) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_type,
    values_from = biomass) |> 
  mutate(
    eel_alg_ratio = case_when(
      algae > 0                    ~ eelgrass / algae,
      algae == 0 & eelgrass > 0    ~ Inf,
      TRUE                         ~ NA_real_
    ),
    alg_eel_ratio = case_when(
      eelgrass > 0                 ~ algae / eelgrass,
      eelgrass == 0 & algae > 0    ~ Inf,
      TRUE                         ~ NA_real_
    ),
    site          = reorder(Site, Latitude, FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    site_position = as.numeric(site)
  )
```
```{r Chisasibi fig}
ratio_chis <- ggplot(
  quadrat_biom2025 |> 
    filter(is.finite(alg_eel_ratio),
           alg_eel_ratio > 0,
           site %in% c(
      "CH38-00",
      "CH38-06",
      "CH34-00",
      "CH33-00",
      "CH03-00")), 
  aes(x = site, y = alg_eel_ratio)) +
  scale_y_log10()+
  geom_boxplot(
      fill = "green4",
      alpha = 0.5)+
  labs(
    y = "Algae / Eelgrass",
    x = "Site")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, 
                               hjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_blank())+
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 1,
    color = "red",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", 
           x = 3, 
           y = 10, 
           label = "More algae", 
           color = "black", 
           fontface = "bold", 
           size = 4,
           alpha = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", 
           x = 3, 
           y = 0.1, 
           label = "More eelgrass", 
           color = "black", 
           fontface = "bold", 
           size = 4,
           alpha = 0.8) +
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 3,
    xend = 3,
    y = 12,
    yend = 30,
    arrow = arrow(
      length = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    ),
    color = "slategray",
    linewidth = 1) +
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 3,
    xend = 3,
    y = 0.07,
    yend = 0.02,
    arrow = arrow(
      length = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    ),
    color = "slategray",
    linewidth = 1)
ratio_chis
```
```{r alg/eel all}
ratio_all <- ggplot(
  quadrat_biom2025 |> 
    filter(is.finite(alg_eel_ratio),
           alg_eel_ratio > 0), 
  aes(x = site, y = alg_eel_ratio)) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = label_number(accuracy = 1))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, size = 2, alpha = 0.7)+
  labs(
    x = "South → North",
    y = "Algae / Eelgrass (Log g dry biomass / 0.0625 m²)"
  ) +
  theme_classic()+
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, 
                               hjust = 1))+
  geom_hline(
  yintercept = 1,
  color = "red",
  linetype = "dashed",
  linewidth = 0.8,
  alpha = 0.5
)
ratio_all
```

```{r eel trend}
eelgrass_trend <-
  ggplot(
    quadrat_biom2025,
    aes(x = site_position,
        y = eelgrass))+
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(group = site_position),
    color = "gray80",
    outlier.shape = NA)+
  scale_y_log10()+
  geom_smooth(
    aes(group = 1),
    method = "loess",
    span = 0.9,
    color = "green4",
    fill = "green4",
    alpha = 0.15,
    linewidth = 1.2,
    formula = y ~ x)+
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = sort(unique(quadrat_biom2025$site_position)),
    labels = levels(quadrat_biom2025$site)) +
  theme_classic()+
  labs(
    x = "Site (South → North)",
    y = "Eelgrass (g/0.0625 m²)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.title.x = element_blank())
eelgrass_trend
```

```{r Site Map}
install.packages(c("tidyverse", "sf", "rnaturalearth", "rnaturalearthdata", "ggspatial"))
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(ggspatial)

country_map <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", country = "Canada", returnclass = "sf")
sites <- st_as_sf(quadrat_biom2025, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326)

main_map <- ggplot() +
  # Plot the base country/region layer
  geom_sf(data = country_map, fill = "gray95", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  
  # Plot your study sites
  geom_sf(data = sites, aes(color = Site), size = 3.5, shape = 19) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-83, -78), ylim =c(50, 57), expand = FALSE)
main_map
```
